description.value: Tuscany Restaurant is an Italian trattoria and pizzeria located just a four-minute walk from Bowen Island's ferry terminal, making it a natural first or last stop for cyclists on a day trip to the island. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, with outdoor seating available. Its intimate setting and proximity to the ferry dock place it squarely at the heart of the island's small but lively visitor scene.
